mapper.select: SELECT *,CAST(manifest_json AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS manifest FROM dictionary_dataset WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT *,CAST(manifest_json AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS manifest FROM dictionary_dataset WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,identity_hash FROM dictionary_dataset WHERE source_hash=#{source} AND dataset_version=#{version} AND converter_version=#{converter}
mapper.update: UPDATE dictionary_dataset SET lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,120,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)),error_code=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='IMPORTING' AND (lease_owner IS NULL OR lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
UPDATE dictionary_dataset SET lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,120,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND status='IMPORTING'

UPDATE dictionary_dataset SET import_phase=#{phase},checkpoint_line=#{line},lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,120,UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND status='IMPORTING'

UPDATE dictionary_dataset SET status='READY',import_phase='DONE',checkpoint_line=0,ready_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,error_code=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND status='IMPORTING'
UPDATE dictionary_dataset SET lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,error_code='IMPORT_INTERRUPTED' WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND status='IMPORTING'
UPDATE dictionary_dataset SET status='FAILED',lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,error_code=#{error} WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_owner=#{owner} AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND status='IMPORTING'
mapper.select: SELECT a.dataset_id,a.version,d.status,CAST(d.manifest_json AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS manifest FROM dictionary_active a LEFT JOIN dictionary_dataset d ON a.dataset_id=d.id WHERE a.slot=1
SELECT dataset_id,version FROM dictionary_active WHERE slot=1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE dictionary_active SET dataset_id=#{id},version=version+1 WHERE slot=1 AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dictionary_entry WHERE dataset_id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dictionary_sense WHERE dataset_id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dictionary_form_mapping WHERE dataset_id=#{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dictionary_entry e WHERE e.dataset_id=#{id} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dictionary_sense s WHERE s.dataset_id=e.dataset_id AND s.entry_id=e.id)

SELECT e.id,CAST(e.metadata_json AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS metadata FROM dictionary_entry e JOIN (SELECT id AS entry_id FROM dictionary_entry WHERE dataset_id=#{id} AND lemma_key=#{key} UNION SELECT entry_id FROM dictionary_form_mapping WHERE dataset_id=#{id} AND surface_key=#{key}) candidates ON candidates.entry_id=e.id WHERE e.dataset_id=#{id} ORDER BY e.source_ordinal,e.section_order,e.component_order
SELECT entry_id,CAST(metadata_json AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS metadata FROM dictionary_sense WHERE dataset_id=#{id} AND entry_id IN #{entry} ORDER BY entry_id,provider_order
